presets.name: MUNICH SEQUENCER
presets.desc: The 1977 sequenced bass: root, octave, fifth and seventh in sixteenths, accents on the beat, a quarter note pump like a kick sidechain and a dotted echo.

presets.name: OCTAVE GALLOP
presets.desc: The galloping octave disco bass: a breathing pulse wave over a round sub, long first note and short answers, a ratchet closing every other beat.

presets.name: STRING MACHINE
presets.desc: A string ensemble playing sevenths in eighths: five stacked saws per oscillator through a slow six stage phaser, the way the old string machines were recorded.

presets.name: NEON GLIDE
presets.desc: An italo lead in eighths that slides into its high notes and ties them, square against saw, a gentle vibrato and a dotted ping pong echo.

presets.name: RIMSHOT PLUCK
presets.desc: A percussive pluck like a tuned rimshot: metallic FM and bright noise through a band pass, swung offbeats, a double hit now and then.

presets.name: BOOGIE SLIDE
presets.desc: A swung boogie bass at 112: square and saw over a sub, slides up to the octave, soft ghost notes between the accents, a warm master.

presets.name: HI-NRG JET
presets.desc: Hi-NRG at 130: octaves in sixteenths on two detuned saws, a jet flanger sweeping over eight bars and a deep pump on every beat.

presets.name: SPACE DISCO BELLS
presets.desc: FM bells in thirty-second notes over two octaves of ninths, some left to chance, a shimmer reverb above and a wide dotted echo.

presets.name: CLAVI FUNK
presets.desc: A synthetic clavinet in swung, syncopated sixteenths: a bright pulse with snapping accents through a funky phaser.

presets.name: LASER RATCHET
presets.desc: Disco lasers: a hard synced oscillator swept down on every eighth, ring modulation for the metal, triple and quadruple ratchets inside the arpeggio.

presets.name: OFFBEAT BELL
presets.desc: The disco cowbell on the offbeats: two squares a fifth apart with ring modulation in a resonant band pass, a double hit ending the bar.

presets.name: SYN TOM FALL
presets.desc: The falling disco synth tom: a sine dropping an octave on every beat, a breath of noise for the skin, the last hit of the bar doubled.

presets.name: THREE AGAINST FOUR
presets.desc: Three notes against the bar, a square and its twelfth in a ladder filter, the cutoff over four bars, a wide dotted echo filling the gaps.

presets.name: FIVE STEP RITUAL
presets.desc: Five steps in a screaming resonant filter: one note ratchets, two play only sometimes, the resonance breathing over eight bars.

presets.name: SEVEN MOON CYCLE
presets.desc: Seven steps turning against sixteen, a slow pulse width in a band pass, a deep slow phaser and a dotted quarter tape echo.

presets.name: DUB ECHO CHAMBER
presets.desc: A dub chord stab in eighths, two hits out of five and the second one uncertain, drowned in a dotted quarter tape echo and a dark reverb.

presets.name: SINGING COMB
presets.desc: A burst of pink noise sets a tuned comb filter ringing: plucked strings that sing the note, nine steps against the bar.

presets.name: RANDOM DROPLETS
presets.desc: Random droplets over two octaves of ninths, each with its own brightness and its own odds of falling, a touch of shimmer.

presets.name: GHOST RATCHETS
presets.desc: Metal ticks for a minimal groove: ring modulated squares through a high pass, ratchets and probabilities on every step so the bar never comes back the same.

presets.name: PENDULUM
presets.desc: Three eighths against eight, tied and sliding, the twin filters spread apart and a left to right swing every half note.

presets.name: ELEVEN ORBIT
presets.desc: A deep sine bass rolling over eleven steps, sliding between its notes, pumping on the beat: nothing above, everything below.

presets.name: WOODEN LOOP
presets.desc: A struck FM wood block over seven steps with a short tuned comb for its body, every hit somewhere else in the room, two of them left to chance.

presets.name: GREY DAWN PULSE
presets.desc: Three long quarter notes against four, stacked saws down low, the wave shape drifting over four bars, a half note pump with a long release.

presets.name: GLASS METRONOME
presets.desc: Nine glass steps against sixteen: a sine and its double octave in a high pass, a shimmer rising in the reverb, a wide dotted echo.

presets.name: ACID CONFESSION
presets.desc: A sixteen step acid line: a saw in a screaming resonant ladder, slides tied into the next note and accents that tear the filter open.

presets.name: SLOW ACID SPIRAL
presets.desc: A hollow square acid bass at 110, five steps that slide and fold on themselves, the wavefolder growling under the accents.

presets.name: CURSED GALLOP
presets.desc: A dark disco bass galloping through an overloaded filter, long growling notes crushed to six bits and pumped hard on every beat.

presets.name: IRON BODY
presets.desc: Hammered and martial: seven stacked saws per oscillator, folded and overdriven, a dry envelope, the fourth hit doubled.

presets.name: NIGHT CRAWLER
presets.desc: A dark descending arpeggio with a reversed filter contour, the notes opening as they end, ring modulation for the grain and a restless phaser.

presets.name: SYNC SCREAMER
presets.desc: A thick hard sync lead, five copies per oscillator spread wide, screaming as the sync sweeps up over two bars, slides between its notes.

presets.name: SUB GROWL
presets.desc: The indie dance bass rolling between the kicks: a big sub, the mixer pushed hard into the ladder, a touch of wavefolding and a pump.

presets.name: BIT CRYPT
presets.desc: An eight bit descent into the crypt: a pulse arpeggio falling over two octaves, crushed to six bits and resampled at 7 kHz, a stereo echo.

presets.name: AURORA ARP
presets.desc: A slow arpeggiated pad over three octaves of ninths: seven stacked saws per oscillator, spread wide, long attack and release, eight seconds of reverb.

presets.name: FROZEN LAKE
presets.desc: FM bells drawn at random from an eleventh chord, half of them left out, very wide, nine seconds of bright reverb with a strong shimmer.

presets.name: VELVET HAZE
presets.desc: Five quarter notes melting together in a closed ladder filter, a breath of noise coming and going, a very slow wide phaser, dark reverb.

presets.name: CATHEDRAL SHIMMER
presets.desc: A triangle and its double octave in a high pass, seven steps way up high, the shimmer climbing octave after octave in a nine second reverb.

presets.name: TAPE MEMORY
presets.desc: A memory on a worn cassette: the tape echo all the way up, the pitch weeping at random, pink hiss, a gentle bit crush and a warm master.

presets.name: SUNSET SWELL
presets.desc: Arpeggiated sevenths that swell twice a bar under a slow half note pump, five stacked saws per oscillator, a long warm reverb.

presets.name: CRYSTAL MIST
presets.desc: A mist of bright noise tuned by a resonant comb and a band pass, nothing below 600 Hz, slow random notes of an eleventh chord dissolving in shimmer.

presets.name: PHASE OCEAN
presets.desc: A low tide of stacked saws and a square below, six slow notes under a full depth phaser and a through zero flanger, each turning at its own pace.
